stories.headline: The Download: testing six tech promises and biotech’s blind spots
stories.dek: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Are we there yet? stories.headline: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
stories.dek: Xbox's first chief operating officer (COO) is leaving after the new role was created just a few months ago. Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today, according to an internal Xbox memo seen by The Verge. Chiang has been at Microsoft for 21 years, serving as the head of Minecraft before being promoted
